2400	Among them was a young man who shifted a little in his chair.	Entre eles havia um jovem que se mexeu um pouco na cadeira.
2401	He wanted to speak, but Rabbi Baruch had said that whoever says something bad about Rabbi Levi Yitzchak would earn the World	Queria falar, mas Rabi Baruch tinha dito que quem dissesse algo ruim sobre Rabi Levi Yitzchak ganharia o Mundo
2402	to Come.	Vindouro.
2403	He wanted to get up, but his friends nudged him, "Ahh, stay put."	Quis se levantar, mas seus amigos o cutucaram: "Ahh, fique quieto."
2404	Friday night passed.	A noite de Shabat passou.
2405	Shabbat morning Rabbi Baruch sits again and tells everyone: if anyone knows something bad about Rabbi Levi Yitzchak,	No Shabat de manhã Rabi Baruch se senta de novo e diz a todos: se alguém souber algo ruim sobre Rabi Levi Yitzchak,
2406	let him say it. I promise him the World to Come, I promise, he won't be harmed.	que diga. Prometo-lhe o Mundo Vindouro, eu prometo, nada lhe acontecerá.
2407	His friends again did not let him up and sat him down in the chair.	Seus amigos de novo não o deixaram levantar e o sentaram na cadeira.
2408	At the third meal he says it once more. That one hadn't caught on yet, and he began to stand.	Na terceira refeição ele diz mais uma vez. Aquele ainda não tinha entendido e começou a se levantar.
2409	Before they could do anything to him, Rabbi Baruch calls him: "Come, come, come, do you have something to say?"	Antes que lhe fizessem algo, Rabi Baruch o chama: "Venha, venha, venha, você tem algo a dizer?"
2410	"Come, come, come, come here."	"Venha, venha, venha, venha aqui."
2411	He says to him, "Yes, I have something to say."	Ele responde: "Sim, tenho algo a dizer."
2412	He told him, "Say it, say it, say it."	Disse-lhe: "Diga, diga, diga."

2417	I went into the synagogue to see.	Entrei na sinagoga para ver.

2419	"Yotzer meshartim va'asher meshartav," everyone standing.	"Yotzer meshartim va'asher meshartav", todos de pé.

2423	"What will Gabriel say?"	"O que dirá Gavriel?"

2425	A man in the middle of prayer, at Yotzer Or, where it is forbidden to speak at all,	Um homem no meio da oração, em Yotzer Or, em que é proibido falar,

2428	It's forbidden to interrupt, it's written in the Shulchan Aruch.	É proibido interromper, está escrito no Shulchan Aruch.
2429	"What will Michael say, what will Gabriel say?"	"O que dirá Mikhael, o que dirá Gavriel?"
